role: A no-lookahead half-month oil strategy with a style-defined ideal policy target, bounded strategy-construction error, persistent thesis invalidation, a registered strategy risk mandate, committee capital authorization, explicit direction/selection/roll attribution, and capacity-constrained weekly execution.
invariants: thesis evaluation uses only the prior published forecast and the newly realized settlement market
configured research capability scores never enter thesis invalidation or recovery
a raw confidence-band exit is observable, but only a configured material standardized breach accumulates thesis failure and a separately configured severe breach invalidates immediately
an invalidated thesis can reduce risk but cannot enlarge same-direction exposure
a material signal reversal exits an existing prior-direction position before opening the reverse direction
the published forecast-location signal remains the base direction and the continuation preference is an l2-normalized overlay rather than a replacement
the eight PM style dimensions define the ideal policy target while three separate construction-capability dimensions only narrow bounded zero-mean proposal error
strategy-construction capability has no aggregate score and cannot read hidden future data, create or reverse a signal, enlarge capital authorization or market limits, or improve execution fills
the default compatibility director has zero construction error so the established default strategy baseline is preserved
the investment committee authorizes a capital ceiling while the PM independently chooses intended deployment inside that ceiling
strategy intent and strategy-risk limits are computed as parallel quantities and compared by clipping; authorization, PM deployment and risk allowance are not multiplied into a serial haircut
strategy risk runs after thesis adjustment; the portfolio-risk extension point is an explicit pass-through while only one strategy is active
the single-strategy runtime has no CRO personnel input and no company-level second clipping
the directional strategy position curve slows only risk-increasing gaps as gross, margin or visible-volatility utilization rises; reductions remain available
direction carry plus contract selection equals named-contract carry pnl
roll and directional rebalance attribution partition net-adjustment pnl and cost without changing account pnl
all roll transfers are matched between legacy exits and same-direction destination openings
buy lots minus sell lots equals net position change and buy lots plus sell lots equals gross turnover
the strategy never changes public prices, market volume, open interest, forecasts or macro rows
